source_read: https://www.leonardohotels.co.uk/<city>/<hotel>/restaurants (41 hotel pages, fetched 2026-10-10; robots.txt on www and media hosts allows all but /booking) and the 10 menu PDFs they link on https://media.leonardo-hotels.com (SHA-256 in tools/uk_extract/leonardo_hotels.py FILES; created 2024-11-22 to 2026-09-24)
not_verifiable: allergens: none published (every menu says to ask a member of the team, the restaurant pages link no allergen table), so nothing was compared
notes: Calories-only chain. Method differs from the script for every row: the picture menus (Bar & Grill main, lunch and Classics, the two kids menus; 56 published rows) have no text layer, so the numbers are typed after being read by eye on 110-150 dpi page images and 500-600 dpi crops, and each is confirmed by tesseract OCR at 300 and 400 dpi (152 of 159 typed dish lines read back by OCR; the other 7, Crispy halloumi fries 501, Twice cooked pork belly bites 518, Tarragon cream sauce 116, Spinach and oat wrap 580, kids Cheesy garlic bread slices 405, kids Classic cheeseburger 631 and Leo's kids Choco Brownie Delight 409, were settled by eye on 500-600 dpi crops). Single OCR passes misread Beef lasagne (245 for 845), kids Fried chicken strips (723 for 733) and kids Classic cheese and tomato pizza (222 for 232): corrected by eye. A second official file per dish was also looked at: Heathrow's own Bar & Grill main and lunch menus print the same calories for every shared dish (prices differ), the Classics room service menu matches the Classics menu, Hinckley Island's Triumph & Piazza menu matches the Lunch menu except Tuna Niçoise salad (388, left out). The 38 published Leo's text-layer rows were compared with the rendered page of the Leo's full menu by eye (every kcal figure on the page matched, including those left out). Left out (48 dishes, listed in the script output as CLASH / OTHER-MENU CLASH): names printed with other calories on another file of the chain, e.g. Crispy squid (428; Bradford room service 343), Rosemary roasted beetroot (447; Hinckley Island 826), Leo's club sandwich (968; Oxford brunch 1034).
